frozen_candidate.algorithm_name: Semantic Primary Loop with Selective Causal Box-Scale Contradiction

source_selection.registry: Wikimedia Commons Category:First-person videos on foot
source_selection.selection_rule: metadata-only eligibility followed by Unicode title ascending
source_selection.selected_title: File:Explore Shanghai's Most Famous Shopping Street at Night on Foot - China Walking Tour.webm
source_selection.fallback_policy: finish and disclose the current source terminal before starting the next already ordered source as a new evidence instance

truth_freeze_before_baseline.overlap_rule: merge overlapping items with the same semantic cause or bind them to one dependency_group
truth_freeze_before_baseline.rationale: small canary floor chosen before payload access to expose more than one event and negative mechanism without pretending population-level power

primary_metrics.absolute_positive_recall: accepted-feedback positive events / all frozen positive events
primary_metrics.baseline_hit_retention: candidate-hit exact baseline-hit positive IDs / baseline-hit positive IDs
primary_metrics.timely_baseline_hit_retention: retained baseline-hit positive IDs within per-event tolerance / baseline-hit positive IDs
primary_metrics.per_event_delay: candidate first accepted timestamp minus baseline first accepted timestamp; candidate miss is positive infinity and failure
primary_metrics.delay_tolerance_rationale: pre-frozen engineering tolerance for asynchronous 10 Hz replay; every exact delay remains reported and no miss can leave the denominator

must_remain_equal: event enter persist and clear rules
may_diverge_only_from_feedback_veto: later feedback eligibility derived from accepted feedback

forbidden: using candidate-only hits to offset lost baseline-hit events
using row reduction as event effect
product safety or real-user efficacy claims
